svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.27.8.5 Lapped Strip Siding
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.27 CLADDING

g.text: Plywood lapped strips on studs, without

svg.text: Plywood applied in horizontal lapped strips
has not less than a 2 mm (1/16″) gap provided
at the butted ends, which are caulked.
The horizontal joints of siding described in
Sentence (1) are lapped not less than 25 mm
Wedges are inserted under all vertical butt
joints and at all corners when horizontal
lapped plywood is applied without sheathing.
B and C drawn to scale, C with the strip tilt shown. Strip width, stud spacing and wedge length are illustration only. The Article does not give a wedge size.
